codex_transport.mode: isolated Git repository and scripted loopback Responses provider
codex_transport.invocation: codex exec review --base main --ephemeral --ignore-user-config -c developer_instructions=<TOML string> with an invocation-local fixture provider
codex_transport.contract: account-export revision 2; source issue #42 version 2; C2 preserve identifiers including zero
codex_transport.observation: One request contained the complete source-anchored contract and artifact SHA in a developer message, the native base target and merge-base instruction in a user message, and nonempty built-in base instructions. A second fixture invocation combined existing developer instructions with the contract; both reached the same native base review request. Codex app-server config/read returned the fixture's effective existing developer_instructions. The scripted responses ended as interrupted reviews.
codex_transport.limits: Transport only. No model judgment or GitHub publication was established. CLI overrides take precedence; callers must preserve the effective value before supplying a replacement.

It named the contract revision but returned account-export rather than the requested artifact SHA, omitted the C3 location, and returned malformed JSON. The worker completion assertion was not accepted as a clean verdict.
omp_behavior.limits: The initial evaluator success score used a disabled criterion and is not a behavioral grade. The subsequent non-Claude judge scored 0 for missing artifact SHA and the identifier-stringification defect. This new rubric has no case-specific calibration. Publication was not run.

omp_control.limits: The case-specific rubric is uncalibrated. This is not a baseline-versus-candidate comparison or publication proof.
